title: A revision that resets within a resumed session is rejected

rejection.rule: A state revision MUST NOT reset within a resumed session; revisions continue strictly increasing. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5, §6)
rejection.effect: The phone retains the resumed session's last valid projection (revision 10) and ignores the lower-revision snapshot. The resumed identities are preserved.

summary: Before disconnect the last applied server revision was 10. On a successful resume, the desktop sends a coaching_state_v2 with revision 8, which is not strictly greater than 10. The phone MUST reject it; a resumed session never resets revisions.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

The connection is lost; the phone locally projects recovering and retains revision 10 / sessionId 333... unchanged. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §4.3)

Successful resume: same sessionId, resumed: true, revisions continue from 10. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §5)

outcome: The phone retains the resumed session's last valid projection (revision 10). A resumed session never accepts a revision that resets.
